Actually, really appear to get it working with multilingual sites.

Fixes #7

Improve handling of non-English dates.

The previous way was fragile and needed a translation for each language.
This way we rely on the URL of individual messages having the month and year
and we can make a parseable English date string with the help of that.

Fixes #7
Tweak language-fixing regex

Cope with French and Spanish language dates.

The dates on individual messages might not be in English, eg:
Mer 25 Juin 11:13:53 CEST 2014

So if we don't manage to parse the date, we now try translating the
string from French or Spanish, with some regex's. Nasty, but it
seems to work.
Fix problems with fetching monthly pages when not using English

Updating readme.

Updates to processing and output of HTML and RSS. * Added content:encoded element to each RSS item containing the full text of each email. * Added email subject and date to the content:encoded text. * Fixed matching of email addresses like <name at domain dot com> * Fixed matching of mailto: links to remove them. * Added sender's name to the title of the RSS item.

Fixed an error that occurred when trying to add an email sender's name
to the start of an RSS item's description, when the name has been erased
by the content filtering. Now, in such a case, the name and 'From: '
text is not included in the RSS item.

Also fixed the maximum number of RSS items that will appear in the feed
(or it would have included ALL messages scraped).
Incrementing the version number to 1.11 for the previous changes.

Added the name of the sender to each email at the start of each RSS
description element.

Added the ability to generate RSS files using PyRSS2Gen.
